params.body:
Closes #1161

## What changes

- `docs/reference.blade.php`: the "Uitleg in gewone taal" link is gone from the reference header. The `/docs` menu right above already links to the guide page. The header keeps the page name and the OpenAPI download.
- Both OpenAPI intros now call the guide "de uitleg met voorbeelden". They keep the link, because the intro also shows in Postman and other tools.

## Checked

Full suite: 3405 tests, no failures.
